workflows.scenario: Display the checking account transaction table from the home splash screen
preconditions: The NGPF Bank Simulator is accessible at https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/home
The simulator contains a pre-seeded checking account with at least one transaction

steps.expected: The splash page loads and GET STARTED NOW button is visible

steps.action: Click GET STARTED NOW to launch the simulator
steps.expected: The browser navigates to /bank-sim/ and the dashboard begins loading

steps.action: Wait for the dashboard and dismiss the welcome dialog if it appears
steps.expected: The dashboard is fully rendered and the welcome dialog is closed

steps.action: Verify the Checking Account Activity card and AVAILABLE BALANCE label are visible
steps.expected: The CHECKING ACCOUNT ACTIVITY card and its AVAILABLE BALANCE label are present

steps.action: Click VIEW ACCOUNT on the Checking Account Activity card
Wait for the Account Activity page to display the transaction table
steps.expected: The Account Activity heading and at least one data row are visible

steps.action: Assert the heading and URL are correct for the checking account page
steps.expected: H2 reads 'Account Activity' and URL contains /account?type=checking

steps.action: Verify the transaction table has the expected six column headers
Verify at least one transaction row is present
Verify the pagination label shows row counts
Verify the SELECT ACCOUNT label and Checking toggle are visible
steps.expected: SELECT ACCOUNT label and Checking button are visible

workflows.test: tests/checking-account-activity.spec.ts#displays the checking account transaction table from the home splash screen
